derived_cause: Asset ORIGIN is implemented in this repository as documentation written once at adoption, never as a machine check at push time, and nothing binds the record to the bytes that ship. Four independent facts produce it. (1) The permitting rule is a set of human-judgement predicates: CLAUDE.md:338 permits owner-commissioned NEW DESIGNS 'with recorded provenance', and its three conditions (CLAUDE.md:359, 361, 365) and five-step test (CLAUDE.md:367-390) are evaluated by the adopting session alone. The only durable artefact is prose, and it is self-attesting: GENERATION_NOTE_background.md:12 asserts 'Externally generated, commissioned by the owner'; :14 names a path on the owner's machine that no longer exists; :15 gives the source SHA truncated with the full value held only under reports/; :21 names the landing path; :22 gives the shipped SHA truncated to 16 hex characters. (2) The one machine implementation of the convention's measurement step, scripts/assets/background_candidate_ingest.py plus its convention-(p) self-test background_candidate_ingest_selftest.py, is an adoption-time INGEST tool and not a gate: it appears in none of the 79 '- name:' steps of .github/workflows/checks.yml and in no npm script, and by its own header (background_candidate_ingest.py:5) it never writes the shipped bg_base.jpg. (3) The two CI steps that touch assets each have a different subject, and each was earned reactively by an earlier, different incident recorded in its own header. asset_reference_gate.mjs (checks.yml:719) runs one direction only, REFERENCE -> FILE: themeStore.ts template paths for the shipping theme plus literal 'assets/...' strings in src, required to exist in dist (asset_reference_gate.mjs:3, 25-29, 130-152), earned by a dangling reference to the pruned bg-1.mp4 (:18-23). It never runs FILE -> RECORD, so a file sitting in public/ that no source references is not examined at all. dist_hygiene_gate.mjs (checks.yml:723) asserts documentation files are absent from dist and the 25 MB budget (dist_hygiene_gate.mjs:1-30, 55-61), earned by a shipped sounds/README.md (:20-28); its subject is the SHAPE of the bundle, not the provenance of its bytes. (4) The positive origin record for in-house art does not close the gap either: scripts/assets/manifest.json declares output_root 'frontend/public/assets/themes/future-spinner' and enumerates everything the deterministic AssetForge pipeline renders from design-system/masters/, but bg_base.jpg appears nowhere in it (zero matches) and no CI step reads the manifest, so an externally supplied file sitting inside the pipeline's own output directory is indistinguishable, to every gate, from a pipeline output. The ship path runs themes.ts:34 (assetBase 'assets/themes/future-spinner') -> themeStore.ts '${b}/backgrounds/bg_base.jpg' -> Vite copying public/ verbatim into dist (vite.config.ts:73-74, 212). The only link between GENERATION_NOTE_background.md:21 and that path is a string both files happen to contain: no step recomputes the shipped hash against :22 (it does still match, measured c7ecfa15dde8db421f3c9428211810c24cf292db6ba49fd149973a6fbffd9491, but by nobody having changed the file rather than by enforcement), and no step enumerates the shipped asset set against the set of recorded ones. The only CI reader of the record at all is the document currency gate, and it reads it for DEAD PATHS only, with the five candidate filenames already accepted into scripts/qa/doc_currency_baseline.json:179, 185, 191, 197, 203. Consequences with every gate green: the record can drift from the bytes; a new external asset dropped into frontend/public/assets/themes/future-spinner/ ships to players unrecorded and unreferenced, the same invisible-ship route convention (o) already recorded costing 7.06 MB of untracked branding/ in the bundle (CLAUDE.md:496-500); and the submission warrant against approval-guidelines.md:21-22 ('assets must comply with intellectual property/copyright law', 'Games must be original designs') rests entirely on unverified prose in four generation records.
reasoning: Derived specification-first per convention (l.1). The specification for asset origin is CLAUDE.md's Assets section as amended 2026-07-27 (line 338), whose three conditions and five-step test are the whole permitting rule; the platform requirement it serves is approval-guidelines.md:21-22. I then read the cited record and every dependency of the ship path. The absence claim was established by enumeration rather than by grep alone: all 79 '- name:' step titles in .github/workflows/checks.yml were listed and none has asset origin, provenance or hash as its subject; the two asset steps at :719 and :723 were read in full and their subjects are reference-to-file existence and bundle shape respectively; scripts/assets/background_candidate_ingest.py and its self-test appear in no workflow step and no npm script. The mechanism is structural rather than accidental: origin is not a property recoverable from a file's bytes, so the convention was implemented as prose, and the two gates over the asset directory were each written reactively for a different, specific, earlier incident (a dangling reference to a pruned mp4; a shipped README) as their own headers record. The confirming measurement (l.2) was that the shipped SHA still matches the record's prefix, which proves the record currently true and simultaneously that nothing is checking it. The FILE -> RECORD direction being absent is the load-bearing half: asset_reference_gate.mjs:141-152 iterates only paths harvested from source, so an unreferenced file in public/ is never in the loop, and Vite copies public/ verbatim (vite.config.ts:73, 212), which is the same route convention (o) recorded shipping 7.06 MB of untracked branding/. scripts/assets/manifest.json, the pipeline's own output list, would have been the natural allowlist and is not read by CI, and bg_base.jpg is not in it.
